You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

What is the regular price of one popcorn? A movie super ticket costs $20 and includes the right to watch any movie. With the movie super ticket, one popcorn and one soda cost $1 extra. A regular movie ticket costs $12. A soda costs $3 at the regular price. The moviegoer did not buy the super ticket and saved $2.
